newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine June rediscount rate rises to 9.892 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine June rediscount rate rises to 9.892 pct.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday that its rediscount rate had been raised to 9.892 percent for the month of June from 9.390 percent in May.
The Central Bank adjusts its rediscount rate at the end of each month. The rate is one percentage point lower than the latest average 91-day Treasury bill rate.
The rediscount window is open to all banks which will relend money to exporters and agribusiness companies.
